question: Which of the following committees was constituted in 1955 for village and small - scale industries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karve Committee**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karve Committee**

 
 
• The **Karve Committee** was constituted in **1955** to focus on the development of **village and small-scale industries**.
 
• It was named after **Dr. D. G. Karve**, a prominent social reformer and economist.
 
• The committee emphasized the importance of small-scale industries in rural areas for employment generation and economic development.
 
• It recommended measures to promote traditional industries, provide financial support, and improve infrastructure for small-scale industries.
 
• The Karve Committee's recommendations played a significant role in shaping India's policies for rural industrialization.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kohli Committee:**

 
 
• The **Kohli Committee** is not related to village and small-scale industries.
 
• It was primarily associated with the **banking sector** and focused on issues like non-performing assets (NPAs) and financial reforms.
 
• The committee was formed much later, in the **1990s**, and not in 1955.
 
• Its recommendations were aimed at improving the efficiency and stability of the banking system in India.
 
• The Kohli Committee is unrelated to the development of rural or small-scale industries.
 
 
 
• **Hussain Committee:**
 
 
• The **Hussain Committee** is not associated with village and small-scale industries.
 
• It was primarily related to **education reforms** and focused on improving the quality of higher education in India.
 
• The committee was formed in the **1990s**, much later than 1955.
 
• Its recommendations were aimed at modernizing the education system and making it more relevant to societal needs.
 
• The Hussain Committee has no connection to the development of rural or small-scale industries.
 
 
 
• **Nayak Committee:**
 
 
• The **Nayak Committee** is not related to village and small-scale industries.
 
• It was primarily associated with the **banking sector** and focused on issues like credit availability for small-scale industries and priority sector lending.
 
• The committee was formed in the **1990s**, much later than 1955.
 
• Its recommendations aimed to improve credit flow to small and medium enterprises (SMEs).
 
• The Nayak Committee, while relevant to small industries, was not formed in 1955 and is not the correct answer.
